## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

```sh

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coil398/dotfiles/master/etc/init.sh | sh
```

hloolx/codpl.body:
# CODPL

CODPL is a static evaluation site for multi-vendor Coding Plan / Code API, used for Coding Plan evaluation, Coding Plan speed testing, Code API Benchmark, cross-vendor model comparison, and long-term trend tracking. The project continuously displays TTFT, MedianTPS, comprehensive experience scores, and historical snapshots of different platforms and models, helping developers see real benchmark results before access, procurement, and model selection.

If you are searching for these contents, this project is prepared for them:

- Coding Plan evaluation
- Coding Plan benchmark
- Coding Plan speed testing
- Coding Plan vendor comparison
- Coding Plan purchase reference
- Code API response speed comparison
- TTFT / MedianTPS / comprehensive experience ranking

## Online Addresses

- Main site: <https://codpl.15o.cc>
- Overseas node: <https://bench.codpl.com/>
- Vendor access status, purchase links, official documentation entry: <https://bench.codpl.com/providers>

The overseas node is provided by Cloudflare and is suitable for overseas network access.

## What the project does

- Continuously probe multiple Coding Plan / Code API vendors and publicly display the latest round of results.
- Compare first-token latency TTFT, MedianTPS, comprehensive scores, and multi-vendor same-model performance.
- Accumulate historical data through static JSON snapshots, making it easy to observe 24-hour and 30-day trend changes.
- Provide developers, team procurement, and model selection with an open, intuitive, verifiable reference page.

This repository is a front-end release repository, retaining only the front-end code and snapshot data needed for static sites, and does not include backend source code, databases, or private environment variables.

## Current vendors covered by benchmarking

The current public page has covered the following Coding Plan / Code API vendors. See [BENCHMARK_COVERAGE.md](https://github.com/hloolx/codpl/blob/HEAD/BENCHMARK_COVERAGE.md) for a complete model list:

metasequoiaime/msime.description: Metasequoia IME (MSIME): A multi-platform Chinese input method for Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and HarmonyOS, using a shared input engine with native hosts on each platform.
metasequoiaime/msime.body:
# Metasequoia IME

Metasequoia IME (MSIME) is a multi-platform Chinese input method for Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and HarmonyOS. Each of the six platforms has its own native input method host, all connecting to the same shared input runtime and the same React settings interface; the React management interface calls a general Rust business library through Tauri; the input algorithm is provided by msime-engine.

Project homepage: [msime.app](https://msime.app/) · [GitHub repository](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime) · [Contributors](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/graphs/contributors) · [Issue feedback](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/issues)

## Star History

> **About the name**: MSIME is an abbreviation of Metasequoia IME (Metasequoia Input Method), unrelated to Microsoft IME and has no association with Microsoft. The code, package name, and repository name use `msime` with this meaning exclusively. The `shuangpin_profile: microsoft` in settings is the "Microsoft Shuangpin" scheme, one of four key position schemes alongside Xiaohezi, Ziran Code, and Shoudo, for users accustomed to that key layout, and similarly does not represent any association.

**Input methods can see everything you type, so this question should have a checkable answer: [What data leaves the device](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md).** Short version: Under default configuration, only cloud word prediction sends the pinyin being composed (to Google Input Tools, can be disabled); other online features require you to fill in credentials to work. Additionally, there is anonymous usage statistics that do not carry input content: all six platforms send daily active, session, and crash records (error summary and stack traces with directories removed) to `api.msime.app`, enabled by default and can be disabled in "Anonymous Usage Statistics" in settings—fields, platform-specific differences, and storage locations are listed item by item in [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md#使用统计与崩溃上报默认开启可关闭). The repository does not integrate any third-party statistics or crash reporting SDKs.

## Module Boundaries

- `crates/client-core`: Host-agnostic client business—local configuration, fixed resource generational installation, accounts and sessions, cloud and AI, skins, word databases, clipboard, voice, translation, typing statistics; does not depend on Tauri, UI, or platform host.
- `crates/input-runtime`: Session orchestration, focus cancellation, candidate pagination and versioned selection; does not replicate engine…

nihaina/SubtitleEditforAndroid.description: A full-featured, lightweight subtitle editing app for mobile, integrating offline speech-to-subtitle conversion, vocal separation, automatic subtitle timing (auto-sync), and format conversion.
nihaina/SubtitleEditforAndroid.body:
# SubtitleEdit for Android

When translating voice and subtitles, it's inconvenient to use a computer. I found there's no suitable software on mobile.

So I created one with the help of AI. The features are referenced from Subtitle Edit, and the operation logic is mainly based on personal usage habits.

Currently mainly perfecting basic subtitle editing features, adding new features while optimizing operation logic and fixing bugs at the same time.

You can quickly sync subtitles based on waveform and spectrogram.

## Main Features

### Subtitle Editing

- **Multi-format Support**: Supports SRT, LRC, WebVTT, TXT formats
- **Visual Editing**: Click to edit timeline and subtitle text
- **Time Offset**: Supports batch time adjustment at millisecond/second/minute/hour level
- **Multi-select Operations**: Supports batch selection, copy, paste, delete
- **Source View Mode**: Directly view and edit raw text content
- **Format Conversion**: Supports batch conversion between SRT, LRC, WebVTT subtitle formats, supports video format conversion
- **Audio Reference**: Can open audio and quickly adjust subtitle timeline based on waveform, supports mp3, wav, flac and other formats
- **Quick Subtitle Sync**: Can quickly insert subtitles on the waveform interface
- **Quick Transcription**: Can perform local speech-to-text for the time segment of partial subtitles, for reference and comparison
- **Quick Translation**: Quick translation and modification application for selected subtitles in the editing interface
- **Quick TTS**: Read selected subtitles for reference and comparison

### Speech-to-Subtitle

- **Multi-model Support**: Supports Whisper, SenseVoice and other sherpa-onnx ASR models
- **Multi-media Input**: Supports selecting audio or video files, supports batch processing
- **Multi-format Output**: Supports generating SRT, LRC, TXT subtitles
- **Speech Segmentation**: Supports using VAD to detect speech segments, can also adjust recognition parameters
- **Runtime Control**: Shows recognition progress and detailed logs, supports cancellation during execution

### Automatic Subtitle Sync

poliakarmai/gsc.description: GSC — verified remediation engine: SAST that proves exploits (PoC), verifies fixes (Proof-of-Fix), and self-heals CI. Apache 2.0 + Commercial.
poliakarmai/gsc.body:
# 🛡️ GSC — Git Security Checker

**SAST that proves an exploit, verifies the fix, and heals CI itself.**

GSC — a self-learning full-cycle AppSec platform:

```
detect → prove → fix → verify → heal → learn
```

## 🚀 Quick Start — GitHub Action

Check your repository in 30 seconds. Add a file `.github/workflows/gsc.yml`:

```yaml
name: GSC Audit
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: poliakarmai/gsc@v1
        with:
          fail_on_critical: false   # true = block merge on CRITICAL
```

Open a pull request — GSC will scan the code, send a comment with findings (CRITICAL / HIGH) and give a security score. The core is supplied as a private Docker image `ghcr.io/poliakarmai/gsc-scanner` — the engine's source code is not published.

**Input parameters:** `path`, `deep_scan`, `fail_on_critical`, `fail_on_score`, `max_findings_to_comment`, `llm_api_key`, `llm_base_url`, `llm_model`, `sarif`, `reachability`.

LLM revalidation — on your key (BYO-LLM):
```yaml
- uses: poliakarmai/gsc@v1…
```

ppxb/miyabi.body:
# Miyabi

An all-in-one Jav & Emby management platform for 115 Cloud Storage.

Miyabi supports direct integration with 115 for scraping and subscription, and can also serve as an underlying service to support Emby.

## Project Preview

## Docker Deployment

> [!TIP]
> You can use AI to help complete project deployment. If you access it over the public network, please pay attention to network security.

Public image:

```text
ghcr.io/ppxb/miyabi
```

### 1. Run with Docker CLI

Please replace `/path/to/data` with your host's data persistence directory, and replace `change-this-password` with a custom password:

```bash
docker run -d \
  --name miyabi \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  --security-opt no-new-privileges:true \
  -p 8080:8080 \
  -v /path/to/data:/app/data \
  -e MIYABI_ACCESS_PASSWORD='change-this-password' \
  -e MIYABI_PUBLIC_URL='http://<host IP>:8080' \
  ghcr.io/ppxb/miyabi:latest
```

> [!NOTE]
> If used with Emby, the generated STRM playback direct links and metadata are output by default in `/app/data/emby` (corresponding to the host directory `/path/to/data/emby`). You can mount this directory to the Emby container as a media library.

### 2. Use Docker Compose (Recommended)

Create a `docker-compose.yml` file:

```yaml
services:
  miyabi:
    image: ghcr.io/ppxb/miyabi:latest
    container_name: miyabi
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - /path/to/data:/app/data
    environment:
      - MIYABI_ACCESS_PASSWORD=change-this-password
      - MIYABI_PUBLIC_URL=http://<host IP>:8080
      # Optional: Pre-set Emby integration directly through environment variables (or configure it in the Web settings page after startup)
      #…
```

yeongseon/kpubdata-builder.body:
# KPubData Builder

**KPubData Builder is a build and warehouse tool that uses KPubData to create reproducible Table Snapshots from public data.**

> KPubData Product Family: [KPubData](https://github.com/yeongseon/kpubdata) is a standalone public data access SDK, **KPubData Builder** is a downstream consumer using its public API, and [KPubData Studio](https://github.com/yeongseon/kpubdata-studio) is a visual workspace for Builder. The dependency direction is one-way: Studio → Builder → KPubData. The repository, Python package, and CLI name is `kpubdata-builder`.

It receives normalized data from `kpubdata`, produces results through Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold), and records them traceable in a Manifest. It reproduces the same output from the same input using a declarative spec called BuildSpec.

[**📘 English**](https://github.com/yeongseon/kpubdata-builder/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

## Why It's Needed

Merely fetching public data is not enough. Working with actual datasets requires the following:

- **Specification-based Reproducibility**: Must be able to reproduce the same results with the same BuildSpec
- **Staged Outputs**: Transparently progress through Bronze (raw) → Silver (normalized) → Gold (deployable) form
- **Deployment Separation**: Distinguish between file creation and publishing to external repositories
- **Audit Trail**: Record spec digest, status, and artifact metadata in Manifest

## Installation

```bash
pip install kpubdata-builder
```

or Docker:

```bash
docker build -t kpubdata-builder:latest .
docker run --rm -e KPUBDATA_BUILDER_API_KEY="${API_KEY}" kpubdata-builder:latest
```

```yaml
dataset_id:…
```
